script:
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$H/goal/stop" --expect 200 --check success eq true --expect-max-ms 3000 --save F11.goal-stop/stop
control-agent-server ws read f11-h --contains '"key": "goal", "value": {"active": false, "status": "interrupted", "iteration": 0, "max_iterations": 10, "objective": "QA_F11 busy objective"' --wait 10
control-agent-server conversation events "$H" --key goal --contains '"status": "interrupted"' --expect-count 1 --save F11.goal-stop/goal-events
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$H" --check execution_status eq running --save F11.goal-stop/still-running
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$H/goal/resume" --expect 409
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$H/goal/stop" --expect 200
control-agent-server conversation events "$H" --key goal --expect-count 2
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$H/interrupt" --expect 200
control-agent-server conversation wait "$H" --until paused --timeout 30
control-agent-server ws stop f11-h --save F11.goal-stop/frames
